Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Shahzad Azeem, Judge
Vide order dated 14.03.2023, it has been observed that merely on the basis of compromise, the charge-sheet for the commission of offence under Section 376 IPC cannot be quashed.
2. In the wake of this observation made by the Court, learned counsel for the petitioners has been granted time to produce the judgment.
3. Be that as it may, today, when the matter had come up for hearing, there is no representation on behalf of the petitioners.
It appears that the petitioners have lost interest in prosecuting the petition.
4. Accordingly, the petition is dismissed in default of appearance and for non-prosecution.
5. Interim direction, if any, shall stand vacated.
6. Registry is directed to communicate this order to the trial Court.

(Shahzad Azeem) Judge Jammu 26.12.2025 Tarun/PS Mohammad Iqbal Pajwal & vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 26 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43426999/
